title: 五种 IO 模型的阻塞点与零拷贝路径的拷贝次数
expected_output:
=== five IO models: which phase blocks ===
    model              phase1 (wait data)           phase2 (copy to user)    blocked?
    blocking IO        block                        block                    yes
    non-blocking IO    poll                         block                    yes
    IO multiplexing    block on select/poll/epoll   block                    yes
    signal-driven IO   async signal                 block                    yes
    asynchronous IO    async                        async                    no
    multiplexing is STILL blocking IO: it only lets you wait on many fds at once
    only asynchronous IO makes BOTH phases non-blocking

=== read() + write() ===
    1. disk -> kernel page cache                     [DMA]
    2. kernel page cache -> user buffer              [CPU]
    3. user buffer -> socket buffer                  [CPU]
    4. socket buffer -> NIC                          [DMA]
    DMA copies = 2, CPU copies = 2, context switches = 4

=== sendfile() ===
    1. disk -> kernel page cache                     [DMA]
    2. kernel page cache -> socket buffer            [CPU]
    3. socket buffer -> NIC                          [DMA]
    DMA copies = 2, CPU copies = 1, context switches = 2

=== sendfile() + SG-DMA (true zero-copy) ===
    1. disk -> kernel page cache                     [DMA]
    2. kernel page cache -> NIC (descriptors only)   [none]
    3. NIC reads page cache directly (SG-DMA)        [DMA]
    DMA copies = 2, CPU copies = 0, context switches = 2

=== conclusion ===
    CPU copies: 2 -> 1 -> 0  (the only true zero-copy is the SG-DMA path)
    context switches: 4 -> 2 -> 2
    sendfile works only when the data is NOT parsed in user space
    that is why Kafka / Nginx / Netty(FileRegion) use it for file->socket
code:
"""五种 IO 模型的阻塞点 + 零拷贝路径的拷贝次数（确定性计数）。"""

MODELS = [
    ("blocking IO",      "block",  "block"),
    ("non-blocking IO",  "poll",   "block"),
    ("IO multiplexing",  "block on select/poll/epoll", "block"),
    ("signal-driven IO", "async signal", "block"),
    ("asynchronous IO",  "async",  "async"),
]

print("=== five IO models: which phase blocks ===")
print(f"    {'model':18s} {'phase1 (wait data)':28s} {'phase2 (copy to user)':24s} blocked?")
for name, p1, p2 in MODELS:
    blocked = "yes" if (p1 != "async" or p2 != "async") else "no"
    print(f"    {name:18s} {p1:28s} {p2:24s} {blocked}")
print("    multiplexing is STILL blocking IO: it only lets you wait on many fds at once")
print("    only asynchronous IO makes BOTH phases non-blocking")

def path_read_write():
    steps = [
        ("disk -> kernel page cache", "DMA"),
        ("kernel page cache -> user buffer", "CPU"),
        ("user buffer -> socket buffer", "CPU"),
        ("socket buffer -> NIC", "DMA"),
    ]
    return steps

def path_sendfile():
    steps = [
        ("disk -> kernel page cache", "DMA"),
        ("kernel page cache -> socket buffer", "CPU"),
        ("socket buffer -> NIC", "DMA"),
    ]
    return steps

def path_sendfile_sgdma():
    steps = [
        ("disk -> kernel page cache", "DMA"),
        ("kernel page cache -> NIC (descriptors only)", "none"),
        ("NIC reads page cache directly (SG-DMA)", "DMA"),
    ]
    return steps

def report(name, steps, ctx_switches):
    dma = sum(1 for _, t in steps if t == "DMA")
    cpu = sum(1 for _, t in steps if t == "CPU")
    print(f"=== {name} ===")
    for i, (s, t) in enumerate(steps, 1):
        print(f"    {i}. {s:45s} [{t}]")
    print(f"    DMA copies = {dma}, CPU copies = {cpu}, context switches = {ctx_switches}")

print()
report("read() + write()", path_read_write(), 4)
print()
report("sendfile()", path_sendfile(), 2)
print()
report("sendfile() + SG-DMA (true zero-copy)", path_sendfile_sgdma(), 2)

print()
print("=== conclusion ===")
print("    CPU copies: 2 -> 1 -> 0  (the only true zero-copy is the SG-DMA path)")
print("    context switches: 4 -> 2 -> 2")
print("    sendfile works only when the data is NOT parsed in user space")
print("    that is why Kafka / Nginx / Netty(FileRegion) use it for file->socket")
